purpose.zh: 练臀部外侧，提升髋部稳定
purpose.en: Build the outer glutes and improve hip stability.

text.zh: 工作腿向外侧抬，骨盆和躯干保持不动
text.en: Lift the working leg out to the side while your pelvis and trunk stay still

text.zh: 一手扶稳椅子，支撑脚踩实
text.en: Hold a stable chair with one hand and keep the standing foot planted.
Return slowly and control the cable.

commonErrors.en: Leaning the trunk sideways to lift the leg.

cautions.zh: 出现疼痛时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: If you feel pain, reduce the range, and stop if it continues.
